{{Quote|No Witch still in our caves survived that night. My mother, my aunts, my oldest sister&hellip;|Kaminne Sihn on her sister's death|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
A '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]''' was the oldest sister of the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] [[Kaminne Sihn|Kaminne]] and [[Olianne Sihn]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Backlash" />

In [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]], an [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|uprising]] of the clan's male [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] occurred which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of over two-thirds of the clan's population. Sihn's sister was among those who perished.<ref name="Backlash" />
